files.transcript: The serpent was cursed to crawl on its belly. God put hostility between it and the woman, and between their offspring. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel. Christians have long read this as the first hint of a savior. The woman would have greatly increased pain in childbearing and conflict in her marriage. The man would work cursed ground through painful toil, among thorns and thistles, until death. For dust you are, and to dust you will return.
